CHAPTER 1

Association for Psychopharmacology. J Psychopharmacology 2020; 34:3–78.
	79.	 Remington G, et al. Treating negative symptoms in schizophrenia: an update. Curr Treat Options Psychiatry 2016; 3:133–150.
